script:
Detective Game Scripts - English Translation
Detective Script
Story Guide:
On June 30th, a sudden rainstorm collapsed a dam. The Kaiyan Reservoir in the mountains was already scheduled for demolition soon. Due to the dam collapse, the water level in the tributary reservoir overflowed, forcing an emergency flood discharge. You were hiking nearby and got trapped here by the heavy rain. However, on the morning of July 1st, after the floodwaters receded, people were shocked to discover a body washed ashore. After identification, this person was Secretary Wang, the representative of the Kaiyan Reservoir reconstruction investor, who went missing yesterday. Since the day before yesterday, apart from Secretary Wang, only a few staff members remained at the reservoir. Now the heavy rain has blocked the mountain road, and the police won't arrive until tomorrow. Through your understanding of the staff, you've gathered 5 staff members related to Secretary Wang. Your intuition tells you that the real killer is among them! *Except for the perpetrator who can lie to you, others cannot lie to you, so please ask them about the case as much as possible to get closer to the truth faster.
About the Suspects:

Zheng Shuang: Former reservoir administrator who resigned four months ago.
Han Hongbin: A middle-aged man with glasses, the reservoir's chief engineer.
Lin Feng: A smooth-talking college student sent by his school for internship.
Liu Gaoyang: A burly man who works as a handyman at the reservoir.
Chen Ning: The reservoir's accountant, an unremarkable woman.

Your Story:
You are an experienced detective who often handles difficult cases. There hasn't been a case you couldn't solve. This time, you were accidentally trapped here.
The deceased, Secretary Wang, was sent by Golden Lion Group to handle the handover work for the Kaiyan Mountain Reservoir acquisition. Golden Lion Group bought the Kaiyan Mountain Reservoir six months ago and plans to renovate it into a resort.
There are five suspects who had significant contact with the deceased: Zheng Shuang, Han Hongbin, Lin Feng, Chen Ning, and Liu Gaoyang. They have now been called before you to assist in the investigation.
You're confident you'll solve this case successfully as well!

Liu Gaoyang's Script
Personal Profile:
Liu Gaoyang: Handyman at Kaiyan Mountain Reservoir, a physically strong man.
Story Guide:
[Same as detective script intro]
*The detective is definitely not the killer. You can share your information and discovered clues with the detective and cannot lie.
*When discussing the case with other players, since you're unsure who the killer is, you can selectively lie to other players, but it's best not to lie constantly, or you'll easily make others suspect you and let the real killer escape.
About the Deceased:
Secretary Wang was the investor's representative, usually arrogant and dismissive of staff like you.
Although you were once enthusiastic toward Secretary Wang, he avoided you like the plague, making you very embarrassed. Later, for certain reasons, you developed hatred toward Secretary Wang.
Your Story:
You are a handyman at Kaiyan Mountain Reservoir, responsible for moving and dismantling tasks that don't require technical skills. Although you lack education, you've always believed that every profession has its masters. Initially, you worked diligently at the reservoir, treating work and colleagues with enthusiasm, helping everyone within your means, earning unanimous praise and improving your relationships. You were once full of hope for life.
However, after Golden Lion Group took over the reservoir in the first half of this year, Secretary Wang, who was responsible for handover and work arrangements, seemed very unfriendly to you all, always stern-faced, not only humorless but also very dismissive. You felt helpless and powerless but believed that with enough enthusiasm, you could eventually change his attitude.
Unfortunately, you were wrong. Secretary Wang remained cold throughout, showing no signs of softening. You couldn't help worrying about your future prospects. Fortunately, your son found a job this year in construction engineering in the city. Though hard work, it was decent, which comforted you greatly. You had to put aside your frustrations and encourage your son to work wholeheartedly, believing everything would get better.
Things didn't improve as you hoped; they got worse. A month ago, while you were working, terrible news came: your son had an accident at the construction site and was seriously injured and hospitalized. You rushed to the hospital and saw your son covered in bandages, lying unconscious in bed. Just as grief overwhelmed you, someone from the construction team came to handle the matter. Unexpectedly, it was Secretary Wang - the project was also under Golden Lion Group.
Secretary Wang maintained his usual indifferent attitude, especially upon seeing you, appearing very impatient. He casually stuffed a stack of money into your hands, seemingly unwilling to spend much effort on this matter. This attitude infuriated you, and in your hot temper, you began cursing Secretary Wang. He pointed his finger at your nose, telling you that after the reservoir was demolished, you would all be fired by the company - not one would remain.
Watching this arrogant man's finger waving in front of your face, especially that broken electronic watch almost hitting your face, made you furious at this weak but pretentious person. Anger rose from your heart, and you punched Secretary Wang in the face. The frail man couldn't take it, bleeding from his mouth as he fell to the ground. He stood up dizzily, wiped the blood from his mouth, threatened that you would pay the price, and hurriedly left.
After this incident, you knew you couldn't stay at the reservoir much longer. Although Secretary Wang hadn't taken any action, after thinking it over, you decided to return to the reservoir on June 29th to pack your things and leave. But before leaving, you decided to find an opportunity to beat Secretary Wang up to vent your anger.
On the evening of June 29th, you waited in the shadows outside Secretary Wang's room, and when he wasn't paying attention, you put a sack over his head and gave him a good beating, finally venting your anger.
On June 30th, a rainstorm trapped you at the reservoir, and Secretary Wang mysteriously disappeared. You pretended nothing happened and stayed with everyone. Unexpectedly, the next day, Secretary Wang's body was discovered by the reservoir.
You're worried that your beating him might be connected to his death, so you decided to investigate the truth behind Secretary Wang's death to clear your suspicions.
About Others:

Zheng Shuang: Former reservoir administrator who resigned four months ago.
Han Hongbin: A middle-aged man with glasses, the reservoir's chief engineer.
Lin Feng: A smooth-talking college student sent by his school for internship.
Chen Ning: The reservoir's accountant, an unremarkable woman.

Your Key Clues (cannot be revealed proactively):

You once had a conflict with Secretary Wang over your son's issue.
You beat Secretary Wang the night before he disappeared.
acts_goal:
Try not to let people discover your conflict with Secretary Wang
Discover the truth behind Secretary Wang's death - if accidental, what caused it; if deliberate, who is the killer and what are their motives and methods
